caption: The drawing depicts a single handbag with a curved handle, shown in a realistic style against a plain light beige background. The handbag appears to be made of a textured fabric featuring a tapestry or embroidered floral pattern. The dominant colors are muted pinks, reds, beiges, greens, off-whites, and hints of blue, especially along the bottom edge and corners. The front flap of the bag has a small round button or clasp at the center, and the handle is covered in a similar patterned material as the bag, predominantly brownish with a reddish floral motif. The floral design on the bag’s main body includes a central rose in light beige and pink tones, surrounded by green and brown foliage and additional red and blue decorative motifs along the edges. The sides of the bag have vertical bands with geometric and floral patterns. The overall composition is centered, with the handbag occupying most of the space and no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Carpet Bag
